1-q: What is the date and time of the wedding?
1-a: The wedding and the reception will take place on Sunday, July 13th 2025 starting at 5pm.
2-a: The ceremony and reception will be held at Stonetree Estate. A map and directions are provided
3-a: The dress code is cocktail attire. We recommend dressing comfortably for the venue and weather.
4-q: Are children allowed at the wedding?
4-a: No, children are not invited to the wedding. It is an adults-only event, with the exception of children who have been specifically requested to participate in the ceremony.
5-a: No, transportation will not be provided. You can find a map and directions
recommendUber: . We recommend using Uber, Lyft, or driving yourself.
6-q: Do you have any accommodation recommendations?
6-a: Yes, you can find the hotel page
7-a: Please arrive by 4:30pm to ensure you're seated before the ceremony begins.
8-q: Will there be a reception following the ceremony?
8-a: Yes, the reception will follow immediately after the ceremony at the same venue.
9-a: We are registered at Zola. Your presence at our wedding is the best gift but if you'd like to contribute, you can find our registry
10-q: Do you have a wedding hashtag?
10-a: Yes! Please use our hashtag #ColinAndOrne2025 to share your photos and memories on social media.
11-a: Please check your invitation for a "+1" indication. If your invitation does not include a "+1", you are not able to bring a guest. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.
12-q: Will there be any special dietary options?
12-a: Please let us know if you have any specific dietary needs when you RSVP. Must request ahead of time.
13-q: What should I do if I can't attend?
13-a: If you're unable to attend, please let us know as soon as possible by RSVPing on our Zola website or contacting us directly.
14-q: Can I take photos during the ceremony?
14-a: We kindly ask that you refrain from taking photos during the ceremony so our photographers can capture the moments. Feel free to take photos during the reception!
15-q: Who can I contact if I have more questions?
15-a: Please reach out to Ornella or Colin at thefranwedding@gmail.com if you have any additional questions or concerns.
